# NOTE the registrar splits the 15 credits into 12 at 3000:4999 plus 3 at a
# lower level. No wildcard type expresses a level split, so packs/marketing/
# models the SUBJECT list only and over-admits low-level credits — see
# docs/known-data-gaps.md. Only the 3000-level line is parsed by the tests.
